d: Wild, spiked crimson red hair and a matching crimson red braided topknot. Glowing incandescent white eyes with a menacing expression. Apparent age is indeterminate, appearing as a mature, demonic figure. Heavily muscled build. A tattered dark grey kimono tied with a deep purple rope belt. Signature metallic cybernetic plating integrated into the chest and arms, and glowing purple energy emanating from the palms.
